text: The doctor is very meticulous and thorough. I always go to see her. It's really hard to get an appointment, but I haven't had any problems with the procedures I've had. The staff are always very helpful and provide good advice. I'm not sure about other people's experiences, but based on my experience, I haven't had any issues.

I was planning to go to the dentist because it's near my house, but after seeing the staff's attitude, I decided against it. They didn't seem welcoming, and getting an appointment was difficult. It's a service profession, but they act like I'm asking for free dental treatment.

Terrible experience. I went for a filling, and they drilled all the way down to the root. Now I need root canal treatment or extraction. When I went back for a fix, they wouldn't fix it, saying I had to wait in line. The waiting list is incredibly long; it's extremely difficult to get an appointment. Even after waiting in line, they said they would check if there was a slot available, but they didn't know when that would be. What does that even mean? Completely unethical and irresponsible. They should quit being doctors. The staff was also terrible; they didn't answer questions and spoke very rudely. In short, everything was awful, from the doctor to the service. It's unbelievable. They knew I was in so much pain from their work. They lacked any medical ethics whatsoever.

Giving it 1 star. They hung up before we finished talking. Probably didn't want a customer. I only asked about the price of root canal treatment for my front tooth, not even a crown yet. They hung up just as I was about to ask something else. Very confusing.
